offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures microturbine energy systems that generate onsite power and heat for commercial, industrial and oil and gas customers. It also sells parts and provides maintenance and energy services, delivered through distributors and direct sales worldwide.

primary_products.value: microturbine energy systems; hybrid power systems; replacement parts and accessories

primary_services.value: maintenance and service contracts; energy asset management; remote monitoring

customer_segment.value: B2B: oil and gas operators, commercial and industrial facilities, utilities, microgrid developers

end_markets.value: oil and gas; commercial and industrial power; utilities; microgrids

revenue_model.value: product sales: microturbine units and systems sold to power users; service fees: maintenance, parts and service contracts after installation

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds microturbines from purchased components, sold to power users and distributors; service provider: maintains installed units under service contracts for equipment owners

geography_served.value: global: Sells and services installations across North America, Europe, Asia, the Middle East and other regions

specialization.value: niche specialist: microturbine energy systems, with related parts and services for the same units

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: independent distributors and channel partners in multiple countries; direct sales: direct sales to large commercial, industrial and energy accounts

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: emissions, product safety and electrical certification rules for onsite power equipment, such as UL and CSA standards

notes: The company emerged from a 2023 Chapter 11 restructuring, so its current business mix may differ from earlier years.
